scope: Engineering prerequisite: versioned closed-call dependencies, selective invalidation and portable revalidation
teaching: Existing public Agent API, bounded I/O examples; no supplied target programs
baseline: v14 frozen implementation; regression must demonstrate that a disproved source leaves a stale caller active
required_checks: A contradicted source invalidates every dependent caller, including nested calls
Unrelated skills and independently admitted copies remain available
Replacing a source with different behavior invalidates callers; identical behavior preserves them
Failed admission and failed publication preserve the original seed atomically
A resumed seed enforces the same dependency graph
Missing, stale, fabricated and cyclic dependencies are rejected
New dependency-bearing seeds require codec v5 and reject false older version labels
Legacy v2/v3/v4 inference remains readable; tracked migration is explicit on adaptation
Metadata and invalidation are real events/results, not simulated telemetry
Existing algorithm, structural and Agent regressions pass

acceptance.audit: Independent contract tests plus real-core curriculum and portable child
